fully mocked, no network; base = main once queue/0082 is merged — the line

the PR and the merge are the operator's.

Facts (seat, 2026-11-01). Two good runs cannot be ingested as delivered.
artemis-helm queue/0005 (artemis_home): the first audit failed on a scanner
false positive (0081), the operator merged PR #18, and the re-audit says
`containment FAIL refs changed besides the work branch: moved refs/heads/main`
with every other check PASS — `refs/heads/main` `aa18384` → `cbb9d1a`, and
`git rev-list --parents -n1 cbb9d1a` = `cbb9d1a aa18384 ecbd40f`: one merge
commit whose parents are the old main and the audited tip, `refs/pull/18/head`
= `ecbd40f`. kestrel-helm queue/0081 (this repo): PR #41 was squash-merged
as `a5ec494`, parent `6af0114` (the old main), `git diff --quiet c8c8a05
a5ec494` exit 0 (same tree as the tip), `refs/pull/41/head` = `c8c8a05`; its
re-audit will fail the same way. `_account_for` (`core/cloud_audit.py`
310–350) accounts for a moved default branch only when `old..new` holds
none of the work (`moved_in & work` empty, 345–350: "someone else's merge");
a main that carries the work FAILs by design (docs/cloud.md 258–262,
`test_containment_main_moved_to_include_a_work_commit_fails` 429–436),
because during the run that shape would mean the run pushed to main. After
the run, the same shape with a `refs/pull/<n>/head` equal to the tip means
the operator opened a PR (their act, already accounted as (b)) and merged
it (their act). `spawner cloud ingest` writes `outcome: aborted` on any
verdict but PASS (`core/cloud_ingest.py` 289), so a post-merge audit can
never yield a delivered row today.

Do this. (1) `core/cloud_audit.py`: after `_rev_list` (305–307) add
`def _merge_shape(run: _Runner, check: Check, clone: str, old: str, new: str,`
`                 tip: str, moved_in: set, work: set) -> Optional[str]:`
with the docstring `"""How old..new took exactly the work base..tip, or None."""`
and this logic, in this order: if `new == tip` and `moved_in == work` →
`"fast-forward"`; else read `code, out = run.git(check, ["rev-list",
"--parents", "-n1", new], clone)`, `parents = out.split()[1:]` (None on
`code != 0`); if `moved_in - work == {new}` and `sorted(parents) ==
sorted([old, tip])` → `"merge commit"`; if `moved_in == {new}` and `parents
== [old]` and `run.git(check, ["diff", "--quiet", tip, new], clone)[0] == 0`
→ `"squash"`; else `None`. (2) `_account_for` (310): add a last parameter

`    return (f"the default branch took this run's work by {shape} of {tip[:12]} "`
